remaining_reasons: Each note row now has a short oval bar and a substantially longer continuous horizontal bar, replacing the source's two compact irregular gray-mark groups with different small-stroke lengths and spacing. Restore the source's irregular groups and compact footprint rather than long continuous bars or invented writing.

The source's distinct small dark right-edge tab is still absent. The return has only torn/notched paper contours, not the compact tab at the source position and scale. Restore that tab without substituting a large tear, clip or fold.

hair_features.reason: The receding crown, short gray-brown side/back hair and sideburns, dark brows and clean-shaven chin remain, without glasses, a moustache or a beard.

collar_fit.reason: The white pointed shirt collar and dark tie meet the rounded chin with a short broad transition, without a pinched collar, long neck column or floating garment.

entries.positive_observation: The yellow mascot retains green-ringed black eyes, receding short side/back hair, dark brows, one stern closed mouth, the viewer-left pose, dark suit, white shirt and dark tie. The photographic frame/backplate and largely blank lower note remain.
entries.alpha_decision: Native RGBA is 2048x2048 with alpha extrema 0..254. Counts are 0=1790120, 252=969670, 253=1292206, 254=49 and 255=0. White/cyan/alpha comparisons show no visible interior holes or lost photographic backing; internal 252-254 values are not rejection grounds. The missing source tab and changed note marks remain visible RGB/exterior defects, so this is not approved and no alpha-only substitution is claimed.
entries.visible_limitations: Readable note glyphs and fine tie weave cannot be resolved at 65x67. The rejection relies on the visible long bars, changed grouping and missing distinct tab, not guessed text.
